Lyu-Welsh limiting RESI for a three-level lmer fit

Source: R/mixed_simulations.R
lyuLimitResi.Rd

Evaluates the g, m -> Inf limit (Lyu & Welsh, 2022) of the per-unit covariance of the fixed effects and the corresponding RESI at the fitted parameters. Between-school columns: n_g Var(beta_b) -> tau2_school C^-1, C = g^-1 sum_s x_s x_s'. Within-school columns: the school intercept acts as a fixed effect, so I_w / N = N^-1 sum_s (A_s - b_s b_s' / c_s). The between and within blocks are asymptotically independent.

Usage

lyuLimitResi(fit, school = "schoolid", child = "childid:schoolid")

Arguments

fit

A `lmerMod` fit with a school random intercept and child-level random effects (intercept and optionally slopes), e.g. `y ~ X + (1 | school/child)`.

school, child

Names of the school and child grouping factors in `lme4::getME(fit, "flist")`.

Value

List with `coefficients` and `anova` RESI tables, the logical `between` indicator per column, and the per-unit limiting covariance `V`.
